scope: Goal-focused, at the user's direction: ss 20(3)-(7), 21(1), (3)-(4), 22(1)-(4), (7), 26(1)-(5), 30(1), (5), 31-35, 37(1)-(4) of the revised text as at 20 March 2026. Findings of fact are inputs. Left out on purpose: nationality (Part 1), inadmissibility and accommodation, appeals and legal aid, s 36, s 38, Parts 3-6.
